entities.name: main road (the outer road east, from the palm-covered carts to the moorings)

From u ~13240 the north walls of the south row, all hidden behind their own roofs and est as in part 1 (under the nearest roof line, or the north gable peak plus ~5 m): the small gable roof S4b.bld.south_gable_shed_13380 (~1700), the big hall S4b.bld.south_hall_13920 (its west side ~1690 at u 13600, its north end ~1475 under the north gable peak (14145,1080)), the small hipped building S4b.bld.south_hip_roof_13810 in front of it (north wall est ~1390; a man stands on the road just behind it), structures_e's long hall (S4b.bld.south_hall_long_14680, north wall est ~1440-1455 under its ridge at v 1240-1265, u 14100-15212) and its east gable foot (15262,1460), then the north end of structures_e's diagonal hall (S4b.bld.south_hall_diagonal_15242, north gable peak (15500,1304), north side est ~1600). The strokes do not settle it: conf low. entities.name: the 汴河 at the moorings
entities.what: The 汴河's westernmost reach in S4b: a basin of open water left as plain silk with small scattered ripple ticks and a few swirl eddies near the bank, holding five boats moored side by side with their west ends at the bank and a sixth along the far bank at the top; it opens east toward the Rainbow Bridge (S3).
entities.vis: part: boats cover most of it; the far shore is behind the small cabin boat; willow whips and roofs cover the south shore east of u 15050
entities.src: sections.md §2 S4: riverside moorings ≈ 14400–15700
entities.note: No shoreline is inked. shore_s (the near bank, south and west of the water) is read where the bank's dark wash streaks stop and the ripple ticks and swirls begin: the landing in front of the top-left building (v 203-242 at u 14860-15025), along the boats' west ends (hidden behind the long-cabin boat's west end, est), the first ripples at (14778, 455), swirls at u 14768-14808 v 617-672 round the mooring post (14738, 662), then the dark edge band running SE (14900, 778)-(15040, 862) with ripples above it at u 15025-15110 v 815-850; east of 15050 it runs along the back of a roof and under willow whips (est, v 875-896). shore_n (the far bank, north) is hidden behind the small cabin boat (hull v 77-160): est v 112-122, south of the far bank's top at v ~80. THE WEST END: the strip u 15030-15180, v 85-150 between the top-left building and the far bank is read as land (a landing; faint wash, no ripple ticks; the restyle paints sand there), so in S4b the water does not reach the silk's top edge (conf low). Other reading: it is the far bank's south face (top v ~81 = the shed's ground line, foot v ~150 = a faint stroke at u 15050-15103), and the water reaches up to it. SEAM u 15500: shore_s v ~896 (est, under willow whips), shore_n v ~112 (est); both run on east into S3 (S3's near shore lies at about v 900-1000 by 十千脚店, its far bank at the top). The restyle paints the water as a pale sheet; nothing here is taken from its colour edge.

entities.name: the big cabin boat and the man on its roof

entities.name: the arched-awning boat and its boatman

entities.name: the long boat and its two boatmen

entities.name: the first palm-covered cart, waiting
entities.what: The first palm-covered family cart stands unhitched on the north side of the road: a small figure waits at its west end and a person sits under the thatch at its front.

entities.name: people at the official hall's east bays

entities.name: customers at the shop table east of the hall

entities.what: An open-fronted shop at the bottom edge, under a long lattice eave: tables (one with a tray), a long bench, a dark jug, a slatted rack and a frame at the back, a tall barrel at the front; a faint figure sits at the tray table and a man in a light jacket stands at the front by the barrel.

entities.name: the crowd round the seated man
entities.what: Thirteen people under the east end of the big sloping roof: a man seated on the ground bends over dark patterned goods spread in front of him, and twelve stand round him in two rows watching (men in dark caps and long robes or short jackets, one youth, one small half-hidden figure); two old bare trees rise from the crowd's back.
entities.src: sections.md S4: a crowd around a seated man under an awning (≈ 13100–13450), identity unchecked; Hansen pl. 17–18 'the wheelwright, storyteller and fortune-teller'

The seated man has no signboard, table or awning of his own (the 'awning' is the big sloping roof's east end), so storyteller, fortune-teller or pedlar stays open. Not members: the man in the shed behind (S4b.fig.man_in_shed_13220, looking away), the porter with the tall load below the crowd (S4b.fig.porter_tall_load_13402) and the man with a pole and basket at u ~13533 (t3's).

entities.name: the top-street stall

entities.name: the wheelwright's yard (车铺劳作)

entities.name: pack mules on the top street
entities.what: Three (perhaps four) pack mules with dark hatched loads on their pack saddles stand facing west on the street at the top of the silk, heads down or raised; a man walks at the front mule's head (the muleteer), and another man watches them from behind the big tree.

entities.name: goods stall under the wheelwright's shed

entities.name: a man and a small companion on the bank
